notes.title: End of year update 2023
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce the release of a major update for Retro Drive Revamped, bringing exciting new features, improvements, and content to enhance your retro racing experience. Here's what's new:

[olist]
[*] [b]Tapes Placement Fix:[/b]
We've heard your feedback loud and clear - tapes should be a reward, not a punishment! With this update, tapes are now properly placed on the screen, ensuring a fair and enjoyable challenge for all retro racers.
[*] [b]Save System Enhancement:[/b]
We've thoroughly checked and improved the save system to ensure its viability for seamless future content additions. Your progress is now in safe hands, ready for new adventures on the horizon.
[*] [b]Audio Pitch Issue Resolved:[/b]
No more unexpected pitch changes! Going from level 9 to level 1 will no longer cause audio issues. Say goodbye to pitch shifts during game over incidents like hitting a camper van.
[*] [b]City Level Stuck Fix:[/b]
Getting stuck facing up in the city level is now a thing of the past. Glide through the cityscapes smoothly and without any unexpected roadblocks.
[*] [b]Crisp Pixel Art in Credits:[/b]
We've sharpened up the pixel art in the credits, ensuring a clearer and more visually pleasing acknowledgment of the talented individuals who contributed to Retro Drive Revamped.
[*] [b]AICar_Red (7) Correction:[/b]
The notorious red car at the start of level 8 has been tamed. Prepare for a fairer race without any unexpected challenges from this particular rival.
[*] [b]Map Menu Music Fix:[/b]
Levels now have the music they deserve! The map menu is no longer silent - enjoy the soundtrack as you navigate through the different levels.
[*] [b]Oil Slick Balance Adjusted:[/b]
Oil slicks are now more balanced, offering a challenging yet fair obstacle for players. Navigate the tracks with precision and skill without the frustration of unbalanced gameplay.
[*] [b]Japanese Font:[/b]
Our Japanese font has passed the test! Retro Drive Revamped is now even more accessible to our Japanese players, ensuring a smooth reading experience.
[*] [b]Multilingual Tips:[/b]
Tips are now localized, providing helpful advice to all players, regardless of language preference. Get ready to race with confidence, no matter where you're from.
[/olist] 

Thank you for your patience and valuable feedback. We're committed to delivering an optimal racing experience, and we can't wait to see you on the improved tracks!
